## Extra integrity measures (beyond the brief)
- Adversarial verifier reports for every optimisation lens and for v2 (`research/v2/*/verify_*`, `research/v2/verify_v2/`).
- A blind test on 11,307 never-examined markets, pre-registered before any result (`research/v2/expand/PREREG.md`).
- The blind forward test on matches played after the pre-registration (`HYPOTHESIS_V2.md` A1, A2, A4;
  `scripts/forward_test.py`; every run logged in `results/forward_peeks.log`).
- A rigor pack: deflated Sharpe, PBO, block bootstrap, minimum track record (`research/rigor/RESULTS.md`).
- A red-team pass (`bash run.sh redteam`, `results/redteam/`): stamp-lag robustness, every derived number re-read from its
  results file, claim checks on the paper, video, deck, README and Devpost text.
- The live paper session was stopped by a team decision and is not used (`research/v2/maker/DEVIATIONS_LIVE.md` L15).
- The code is read-only and never places an order.
